kicker: The network where devs get unblocked
lead: Ask your problem, see if it is already solved, run the repro and get back to coding. Here the feed is ranked to unblock you, not to keep you.
featuresTitle: Three things you won’t find elsewhere

f1.title: An explainable, steerable feed
f1.text: Every card says why it is there. You set the weight of each topic, or say “less of this”.

f2.title: Already solved?
f2.text: While you write your problem, we show the ones that look like it and have a solution.

f3.title: Runnable repro, fork & fix
f3.text: The bug runs in the page, in a sandbox. The answer can carry the fixed version.

s1.title: Pick your topics
s1.text: Or import them from your GitHub username.

s2.title: Ask or solve
s2.text: An analysis suggests topics, level and first leads. You stay in control.

s3.title: Close the loop
s3.text: The accepted solution stays findable for the next person who is stuck.

ethics: Our metric is not time spent, it is the number of problems unblocked. The feed keeps a share for exploration so you are not locked in, and everything it learns about you is visible and editable.
footer: Student project entered in a competition.
